question: Tribal leader Birsa was associated with which tribe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Munda**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birsa Munda **was associated with the** Munda tribe,** which is predominantly found in the** Chota Nagpur Plateau region** of India.
 
• He was a prominent figure in the **Indian independence movement** and fought against the British colonial rule.
 
• Birsa Munda is known for his **rebellion against the British in 1895**, which is now known as the **Birsa Munda Ulgulan.**
 
• He was a **visionary leader** who fought for the rights of the **tribal people** and **their land.**
 
• Birsa Munda's legacy continues to inspire the **Adivasi movement **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhil** is a community found in central and western India, mainly in the states of **Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra.**
 
• **Gond **is a tribe found in central and western India, mainly in the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.**
 
• **Bhutia** is a community found in the Himalayan region of India, mainly in the state of **Sikkim**.
 
• They are known for their **unique culture and traditions.**
